widgets_values:
Image 1: A young East Asian man with tousled dark brown hair, wearing an ivory textured suit jacket with an oversized cream fabric ruffle across the right shoulder, a white dress shirt underneath, ivory straight-leg trousers, and ivory derby shoes. Studio portrait, soft neutral lighting, clean white background.

Image 2: A young East Asian woman with long wavy dark brown hair falling past her shoulders, wearing a white short-sleeve t-shirt printed with a cartoon bunny and small pink hearts, a light blue denim mini skirt, ivory mary-jane shoes, and small green jade stud earrings. Studio portrait, soft neutral lighting, clean white background.

Image 3: A vintage interior hallway. Cream textured plaster walls, an aged distressed teal-turquoise paneled door standing half-open revealing a wood-paneled library study with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, a small writing desk, and a red oriental rug. A brass wall sconce with stained-glass shades casts warm amber light. An antique brass coat rack on the left wall holds a brown leather messenger bag and a tweed coat. Dark oak plank flooring with a single brown leather lace-up boot and a small stack of antique leather-bound books. The right wall carries a gallery of framed botanical prints in gilt frames. Warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field.

[Shot 1] Tracking shot from a low-medium angle, the camera glides forward along the right wall of Image 3's vintage hallway, following Figure 2 as she walks at a relaxed pace toward the open teal door. Her long dark hair sways gently with each step, the white bunny t-shirt and denim skirt clearly visible. Figure 1 is revealed ahead near the doorframe, his ivory ruffled suit catching the warm amber light from the sconce. The coat rack with the leather messenger bag and tweed coat slides past on the left. Camera moves forward 30% along the hallway axis. Soft footsteps on oak floor, ambient warmth.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a medium two-shot at slightly low angle. Figure 1 and Figure 2 now face each other in the center of the hallway, standing about an arm's length apart, warm amber light wrapping around both faces, the teal door and the gallery of botanical prints softly out of focus in the background. Camera slowly orbits 20% around them from left to right. Figure 1 looks at Figure 2 with a gentle smile and says softly in Mandarin: "好久不见。"

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, cut to a close-up of Figure 2 from the chest up, framed slightly over Figure 1's ruffled shoulder in soft foreground bokeh. Camera slowly pushes in 15% on her face. She looks up at Figure 1, her dark hair catching the amber light, and replies warmly in Mandarin: "是啊,好久不见。" Her eyes crinkle gently as she speaks.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, cut to a close-up of Figure 1 from the chest up, framed slightly over Figure 2's hair in soft foreground bokeh. Camera slowly tilts up 5 degrees while pushing in 10% on his face. He tilts his head slightly and replies softly in Mandarin: "你还是和以前一样。" A gentle, warm smile spreads across his face.

[Shot 5] At 00:09.500, cut to a wide dolly-out shot. Both figures stand close together in the center of the hallway, softly lit by the brass sconce, the teal door half-open behind them, the coat rack and the gallery of botanical prints framing the composition. Camera pulls back smoothly 25% along the hallway axis, revealing the full depth and warmth of the space. Figure 1 and Figure 2 share a quiet moment, looking at each other with soft smiles. Soft ambient sound, distant birdsong, a faint brass tone underneath.
